sentences.text: Researchers employed indirect treatment comparisons to evaluate nusinersen against onasemnogene abeparvovec-brve, matching data from nusinersen trials with the STEER trial for treatment-naive patients and pairing DEVOTE Part C with the STRENGTH trial for those with prior treatment.

Motor function changes were measured using the HFMSE and RULM scales, revealing a numerical advantage for nusinersen over gene therapy in young children aged 2 to under 5 years without prior treatment and in patients under 18 years with prior treatment.

The authors noted that a valid comparison between DEVOTE Part B and STEER was impossible, warned that small patient numbers reduce precision, and stated that direct studies are needed to confirm if one treatment is truly superior.
